svg.title: Humanness scores by engineering origin and chain type
svg.desc: Nine panels: three humanness metrics across, three chain types down. Within each panel, one jittered point per antibody chain, grouped by curated engineering origin, with the group median drawn as a flat rule. The accompanying separation table gives the same comparison numerically.
svg.text: Each point is one chain; a flat rule is the group median. Origins run left to right by expected humanness. One shared y scale
(0.2-1); no point is clipped, and points below the chimeric / mouse range are kept in place.
